prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes. SUBJECT: Qingyuan Bell Tower in Xuanhua, Hebei, erected 1482, as viewed from the SOUTH in this real photograph. Landscape 1536x1024, complete monument at 82% canvas width. Preserve its unique cross-shaped plan, cross-gabled roof and THREE eave/storey levels: the central projecting front pavilion rises slightly higher than the left and right wings at every level, creating interlocking roof silhouettes. It is NOT a regular square pagoda, and must not become a generic drum tower with two roofs. Draw exactly the roof stacking visible in the photograph, including central projecting three-eave rhythm, the corresponding side roof units, open balcony at middle level and timber structural posts. It sits on an enormous broad plain slightly tapered RECTANGULAR BRICK PODIUM, roughly two fifths of total monument height, with ONE large semicircular arched central passage at ground level. Keep the entire low block foundation and both podium side edges. Remove plaque lettering, signs, fences, traffic and tree. Portal interior stays pure white, no black fill. Only a few short brick marks to show masonry. Roof planes are blank white with sparse ridge and bracket contour details, full roof tips and top ornaments uncut.

site_recommendation.sub: 十字歇山三重檐钟楼及砖台
site_recommendation.yearNote: 仅选宣化城楼代表一条，不再增加镇朔楼、五龙壁。
site_recommendation.lede: 十字歇山顶层层交叠，钟楼立在宣化古城街心的高大砖台上，南北券洞让街道穿楼而过。

facts.label: 年代
facts.text: 清远楼建于明成化十八年（1482），历代维修，现存主体沿袭明代形制。

facts.label: 结构
facts.text: 楼为三层、三重檐十字歇山顶，中央与两翼屋面前后穿插，形成复杂而清晰的轮廓。

facts.label: 城楼
facts.text: 巨大的砖砌台座中央辟拱券通道；本条以清远楼代表宣化城内楼阁，不另拆邻近楼宇。

quality_check.notes: 已查看实拍与输出，三重檐及交叠侧屋面、单一券洞、完整砖台均保留。
